name: @pipeworx/mcp-revternal

tools.name: revternal_search_developers
tools.description: Search a live index of ~12M developers (GitHub-centric) by role, primary programming language, location, and recent activity — for recruiting, GTM/lead-gen, and developer-audience research. Each result is a matching GitHub username, display name, and profile URL; your search filters are echoed back on the response rather than repeated per result. Filters: role (e.g. "backend engineer", "ai/ml engineer" — spaces/punctuation are normalized to underscores), primary_language (e.g. "Python", "Rust"), location, active_within_days (only devs active in the last N days), sort_by ("last_active", "commit_quality", or "external_contribution_ratio"; default last_active). Paginate with limit + offset — each requested slot costs 1 credit. Requires your own Revternal API key (BYOK) — pass it as _apiKey. Example: revternal_search_developers({ primary_language: "Rust", active_within_days: 30, limit: 20, _apiKey: "..." }).

role.description: Developer role filter, e.g. "backend engineer", "ai/ml engineer", "frontend engineer".

active_within_days.description: Only developers active within the last N days (>=1).

limit.description: Results per page, 1-100 (default 20). Each requested slot costs 1 credit.

_apiKey.description: Your Revternal API key (sent as x-api-key), from https://revternal.com/signup. Required — Pipeworx has no platform key for this pack.

tools.name: revternal_developer_intel
tools.description: Get behavioural intelligence for one developer by GitHub username — how they actually work, not just their bio. Returns work pattern (chronotype, peak hours, work rhythm, activity trend, velocity change), collaboration style (solo vs team, external PR ratio, reviews given), professionalism signals (commit quality, conventional commits, primary work type), and activity recency. Flat 1 credit per successful lookup; a username not yet in Revternal's index answers 404. Requires your own Revternal API key (BYOK) — pass it as _apiKey. Example: revternal_developer_intel({ github_username: "torvalds", _apiKey: "..." }).

_apiKey.description: Your Revternal API key (sent as x-api-key), from https://revternal.com/signup. Required — Pipeworx has no platform key for this pack.

tools.name: revternal_enrich_developer
tools.description: Enrich a developer from their GitHub profile URL — full firmographic + technical profile, computed in real time (cached server-side after the first call). Returns name, location, company, bio, followers/following, repo and gist counts, years active, seniority estimate, a ranked skills breakdown (languages by repo share), top repos, 90-day activity counts, and composite scores (seniority, activity, language diversity, influence, profile completeness). Flat 2 credits per successful call. Use to enrich a lead or candidate you already have a GitHub URL for. Requires your own Revternal API key (BYOK) — pass it as _apiKey. Example: revternal_enrich_developer({ github_url: "https://github.com/torvalds", _apiKey: "..." }).

_apiKey.description: Your Revternal API key (sent as x-api-key), from https://revternal.com/signup. Required — Pipeworx has no platform key for this pack.

tools.name: revternal_people_search
tools.description: Search Revternal's people-intelligence index for any person — not just developers — by job title, seniority, location, current company domain, or skills. Returns matching people with name, headline, and profile fields, plus an opaque cursor for the next page. At least one filter is required. Seniority values: entry, senior, manager, director, vp, c_suite, owner, partner. Countries use 3-letter ISO codes (USA, GBR, IND). Use for recruiting, GTM prospecting, and lead research when you have criteria rather than a specific profile. Requires your own Revternal API key (BYOK) — pass it as _apiKey. Example: revternal_people_search({ job_titles: ["Software Engineer"], countries: ["USA"], page_size: 5 }).

job_titles.description: Current job titles to match, e.g. ["Software Engineer", "CTO"]. A single string is also accepted.

seniority.description: Seniority levels to match: entry, senior, manager, director, vp, c_suite, owner, partner.

countries.description: 3-letter ISO country codes, e.g. ["USA", "GBR"]. Common 2-letter codes are auto-converted.

cities.description: City names to match, e.g. ["San Francisco"].

skills.description: Skills or keywords matched across profile fields, e.g. ["Python", "FastAPI"].

stealth_founder.description: When true, limit results to stealth founders.

cursor.description: Opaque cursor from the previous response (next_cursor) — pass back unmodified to paginate.

_apiKey.description: Your Revternal API key (sent as x-api-key), from https://revternal.com/signup. Required — Pipeworx has no platform key for this pack.

tools.name: revternal_enrich_person
tools.description: Enrich one person from their LinkedIn profile URL via Revternal — full normalized profile: name, headline, current company and title, past work experience, education, skills, certifications, and profile picture. Default (fetch_live: false) reads Revternal's existing record for that URL and returns found:false if there is none; set fetch_live: true to have Revternal fetch a fresh profile (slower, higher vendor cost). Use to enrich a lead, candidate, or contact you already have a LinkedIn URL for. Requires your own Revternal API key (BYOK) — pass it as _apiKey. Example: revternal_enrich_person({ linkedin_url: "https://www.linkedin.com/in/vishalv06" }).

linkedin_url.description: Personal LinkedIn profile URL containing /in/, e.g. "https://www.linkedin.com/in/vishalv06". A bare username is also accepted.

fetch_live.description: false (default): return Revternal's existing profile record, found:false if none (1 credit if found). true: Revternal fetches fresh profile data (5 credits, slower, higher vendor cost).

_apiKey.description: Your Revternal API key (sent as x-api-key), from https://revternal.com/signup. Required — Pipeworx has no platform key for this pack.

tools.name: revternal_credit_balance
tools.description: Check the credit balance, plan, and status for a Revternal API key — free, does not consume credits. Use before a bulk search/enrichment run to confirm you have credits, or to diagnose a "HTTP 402 Payment Required" error from another revternal_* tool. Requires your own Revternal API key (BYOK) — pass it as _apiKey. Example: revternal_credit_balance({ _apiKey: "..." }).

_apiKey.description: Your Revternal API key (sent as x-api-key), from https://revternal.com/signup. Required — Pipeworx has no platform key for this pack.
